name: pusula-is-takip
description: Pusula: Türkçe iş ve ekip takip uygulaması (React + Vite)

scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e/smoke.mjs dist && node tests/e2e/preview.mjs dist-preview
scripts.start:dev: npm run build:pilot && AUTH_MODE=dev PUSULA_ADMINS=deneme@sirket.test DATA_DIR=./tmp/pilot-data node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning server/index.js
scripts.start:mcp-dev: npm run build:pilot && npm run build:mcp-app && AUTH_MODE=dev PUSULA_ADMINS=deneme@sirket.test DATA_DIR=./tmp/pilot-data MCP_ENABLED=true MCP_TOKENS=deneme@sirket.test:gelistirme-anahtari-yalnizca-yerel-deneme node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning server/index.js
scripts.test:mcp-app: npm run build:mcp-app && vite build --config vite.mcp-host.config.js && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/e2e/mcpApp.mjs
